observations: horizontal_one_raw46 proves every raw horizontal triple on j=1, including zeros and the small source case. vertical_boundary_raw46 proves every raw vertical triple on i=0. These do not establish general interior inequalities.

The actual source 2/5 row j=2 is u^2(14+28u+15u^2), has an explicit nonreal zero, and has log-concave raw nonzero coefficients. Real-rootedness of every horizontal row is therefore unavailable as a universal sufficient route.

The 32,767-word scan through length 16 found no horizontal failure, but 2,625 vertical and 5,688 diagonal failures. This is finite evidence for a horizontal-only enlargement, not a theorem or source counterexample: evidence/markov-b46c0efc/word-directions-16.json.

Cyclically balanced ABBABABABABAB fails unrestricted diagonal LC with 2,6,20; one endpoint is outside the canonical 7/13 polygon. The actual source values are 0,4,20. A separate guarded scan of 933 reduced rotations found no failure: cyclic-source-comparison.json and cyclic-polygon-26.json under the same evidence directory.

The published Theorem 4.2 expression gives 6 where the exact 2/3 recurrence gives 4; Theorem 4.1 agrees with 4. This auxiliary formula discrepancy does not refute Conjecture 6.3. Source: https://armj.math.stonybrook.edu/Articles/250708-Winn/index.html.

Successful axiom closures use only permitted axioms. Validation used inherited compiled imports, not an independent full-source rebuild. Root hash is unchanged; all remaining correspondence obligations are recorded in research/markov-b46c0efc-correspondence.md. Capability failures are in evidence/markov-b46c0efc/operational-observations.json.
